title: Technique to perform neural network architecture search with federated learning

pse.problem: Training a neural network that is shared amongst multiple clients presents data privacy concerns due to sensitive training data, and applying static neural networks to unknown input can cause data inconsistencies.
pse.solution_function: In a federated learning setting, the system constructs a unique neural network for each client based on the input they infer. The neural networks from each client are combined to train the overall neural network.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes multiple federated learning client sites with their respective neural network structures, a cloud-based server for data exchange and coordination, and autonomous vehicles as an example use case.
pse.solution_implementation: At each client site, a sub-network is constructed based on the input being inferred. The system selects a neural network using information from inferencing an input at each client site. If a new input is encountered, the system selects a different neural network.
pse.effect: The solution improves the performance of neural networks by addressing data privacy concerns and reducing data inconsistencies caused by applying static neural networks to unknown inputs.
